model.name: File is a modelled M1 class (MOF/MDA) — behaviour not data-bag, owned (never null), fully-qualified IOR, carried whole through DnD
model.description: Model File as a REAL M1 Class (radical-OOP: 'a FILE IS a File class'). Today rb-file-tree emits bare strings ('collection:dir:src/shared/test','collection:file:src/shared/','file:b9fa43a2-...') and File units are broken (ownerIor NULL; {uuid,name,location,kind,ext} data-bag, no backing class). CREATE File CLEAN + NEW as a radical-OOP M1 class (Tron zero-migration: leave the 3 lowercase 'file' ModelElement stubs as legacy, do NOT consolidate/migrate). 3 by-construction guards (owner-never-null / fully-qualified-additive-IOR / class-has-methods). TOP-DOWN, full 6-step chain, no backfill.
model.tronQuote: create a class File and a class Folder during two top down planned sprint tasks with full tracability and as full mda mof chain in a sprint 41: OOP model consistency
model.poDirective: PO 2026-09-12 (Tron build order): File as a real M1 class in Sprint 41, scenario-first, full MDA/MOF chain before code.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The CREATE PATH REJECTS an ownerless File BY CONSTRUCTION (Tron: 'its me as the owner') — ownerIor never null on a NEW File. A GUARD on new creates, NOT a backfill of the existing units. The owner is a fully-qualified instance IOR (Tron / resolved room / user).

gateRef.assertion: create a NEW File with no owner -> REJECTED; remove the create-guard so an ownerless File persists => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: remove the create-guard; an ownerless File is created/persisted -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: NEW File units carry a FULLY-QUALIFIED IOR = CLASS + PROTOCOL + ORIGIN + UUID ('ior:class:File:rest:<origin>/<uuid>', Tron verbatim), and the RESOLVER resolves that new form. ADDITIVE / zero-migration: the legacy bare form still parses and the 212 existing bare refs are NOT rewritten. ORIGIN is mandatory — it makes the ref resolvable ACROSS servers (federation).

gateRef.assertion: a NEW File ref emitted without class/protocol/ORIGIN/uuid => RED; the resolver failing to resolve the new fully-qualified form => RED; a spec that REWRITES the 212 existing bare refs (migration) => out of scope

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: emit a new File ref bare (no origin) OR make the parser reject the legacy form -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: File is a CLASS WITH METHODS (behaviour) — ask-the-object: a file renders/resolves ITSELF via its methods (renderSelf / resolveOwnIor / children). A 0-method DATA-BAG ({uuid,name,location,kind,ext} with no behaviour) FAILS — that is the radical-OOP violation that made the tree emit strings.

gateRef.assertion: a File M1 class with 0 methods (pure data-bag) => RED; the file must answer renderSelf/ior via its own methods

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed a File class with 0 methods (data-bag) -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: File is a REAL M1 Class unit (ior:class:Class name 'File', proper case) in the MOF/MDA chain — radical-OOP: 'a FILE IS a File class'. Every file rendered/dragged/stored is a File-class INSTANCE (M0) resolved THROUGH the class, never an ad-hoc JSON blob nor a computed bare string.

gateRef.assertion: a file surfaced without a backing M1 File Class => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed a file with no M1 File class backing it -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: Dragging a File in rb-file-tree carries the REAL File-class unit (its fully-qualified IOR resolving to the stored unit + owner) through the ONE DnD contract (R37.20/R40.106), NOT a computed bare string ('collection:dir:...', 'collection:file:...', 'file:<uuid>'). Drop places a LINK to that one unit.

gateRef.assertion: a file drag payload that is a bare string instead of a resolvable fully-qualified File IOR => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed a file drag emitting a bare 'collection:file:...' string -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: File is delivered TOP-DOWN through the FULL 6-step MDA chain minted BEFORE any code — Requirement -> UseCase -> Class(M1) -> Method -> Implementation -> Test — NO backfill (Rule #126 purest form). Every chain link on disk before File code ships.

gateRef.assertion: the File chain missing any link at code-ship, OR any link minted AFTER its code (backfill) => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed File code shipped with a missing/after-the-fact chain link -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: The File class is CREATED CLEAN + NEW — a radical-OOP M1 File class existing for the FIRST time (Tron zero-migration re-scope). It is NOT consolidated/migrated/backfilled from the existing lowercase-'file' ModelElement stubs (35f8f879 / a0df222c / bccba82d (ior:class:ModelElement name 'file', owner null)) — those are LEFT as legacy. The new File is the canonical M1 model going forward.

gateRef.assertion: the new File M1 class exists as a fresh radical-OOP class; a spec that migrates/rewrites the legacy stubs (Tron said zero-migration) => out of scope; a File rendered with NO backing M1 class => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed a file surfaced with no backing clean M1 File class -> RED
